verdict.rationale: Context.dev's first-party extraction guide says it crawls relevant pages and returns an object matching a user-supplied JSON Schema, with controls for grounding, coverage, and freshness. That covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that outputs reliably conform to the schema, and documentation of supported schema features and validation or error behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a JSON schema so the API returns structured data matching that schema

citations.quote: Crawl relevant pages and return an object that matches your JSON Schema, with controls for grounding, coverage, and freshness.
Start from a URL, read relevant pages, and return data shaped by your JSON Schema.
